description: An oil painting in dark, warm tones. A large DNA double helix forms a ring across the middle, with one section splayed open at its ends and a thin, different-coloured strand threaded into the gap. Behind it are shelves of glass bottles and flasks, and in the foreground a petri dish of speckled colonies sits on a bench beside tweezers, a flask and an open notebook. No people are visible. The painting runs edge to edge with no frame or border.
